formulas.honest_span: min(frame_span, trade_span, bars_span); claimed≥600 without physical → rejected
formulas.simple_sum: Σ_i w_i where w_i = expected_weekly_fills of can_open strategies with countable methods (excludes weak_prior/insufficient)
formulas.correlation_adjusted_mean: E[Σ X_i] = Σ E[X_i] = Σ p_i for ANY dependence structure. Therefore correlation_adjusted_weekly := simple_sum_weekly (mean-invariant). Correlation only changes Var(Σ X_i), co_signal_prob, co_silence_prob.
formulas.conflict_adjusted: Simulate correlated Bernoulli daily triggers (family ρ=0.55, cross ρ=0.15). Then apply (1) same-symbol mutex max 1 fill/day and (2) same-family co-fire arbitration keeping highest p only. Scale sim conflict rate by target_daily * (conflict_daily_raw / indep_daily). final_fillable := conflict_adjusted.
formulas.why_corr_mean_equals_simple_sum: E[sum_i X_i] = sum_i E[X_i] for any dependence; correlation changes distribution / co-fire probability, not the mean. Conflict adjustment THEN reduces mean via same-symbol mutex + same-family arbitration.
